package readiness

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

const readinessStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestResolveSelectsNeutralFoundationForStudentUnansweredSelectionDeterministically(t *testing.T) {
	base := foundationSnapshot()
	student := &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: base}
	graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
	resolver := Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: student, Graphs: graphs}
	first, err := resolver.Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve unanswered desired stacks: %v", err)
	}
	if first.Result != domain.LearningReadinessReady || first.Goal == nil ||
		first.Goal.Code != "programming.foundation" || first.Goal.Version != "v1" ||
		first.Goal.GraphVersion != "programming-foundation-graph-v1" || first.Executable ||
		first.ContentStatus != domain.ReadinessContentNotCreated || first.ReadinessScope != domain.ReadinessScopePublishedGraph {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected foundation readiness: %#v", first)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(graphs.lookups, []readinessGraphLookup{{
		code: "programming.foundation", version: "v1", graphVersion: "programming-foundation-graph-v1",
	}}) {
		t.Fatalf("foundation lookup is not exact: %#v", graphs.lookups)
	}

	minutes := 15
	pace := "intensive"
	variant := foundationSnapshot()
	variant.Profile.KnownStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{
		State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{"php", "sql"}, ValuesPresent: true,
	}
	variant.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{
		State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{}, ValuesPresent: true,
	}
	variant.Profile.WeeklyMinutes = &minutes
	variant.Profile.PreferredPace = &pace
	student.snapshot = variant
	second, err := resolver.Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve defensively supported answered-empty DTO state: %v", err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(first, second) {
		firstJSON, _ := json.Marshal(first)
		secondJSON, _ := json.Marshal(second)
		t.Fatalf("ignored fields or defensively supported empty-array representation changed readiness:\n%s\n%s", firstJSON, secondJSON)
	}
}

func TestResolveScenarioCSelectsOnlyExactGoBackendRegression(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := foundationSnapshot()
	snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode = "backend"
	snapshot.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience = "advanced"
	snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{
		State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{"go"}, ValuesPresent: true,
	}
	graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
	result, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Graphs: graphs}).Handle(
		context.Background(), readinessInput(),
	)
	if err != nil || result.Result != domain.LearningReadinessReady || result.Goal == nil || result.Goal.Code != "go.backend" ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(graphs.lookups, []readinessGraphLookup{{code: "go.backend", version: "v1", graphVersion: "go-backend-graph-v1"}}) ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(result.ReasonCodes, []string{domain.ReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved}) {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v goals=%#v err=%v", result, graphs.goalCodes, err)
	}
}

func TestResolveScenarioDActivePathHasPrecedenceAndIsObservational(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := foundationSnapshot()
	snapshot.LearningIntent = nil
	snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode = ""
	snapshot.ActivePath = &domain.StudentReadinessActivePath{
		LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Version: 4,
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "existing.goal", Status: "ACTIVE",
	}
	graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
	result, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Graphs: graphs}).Handle(
		context.Background(), readinessInput(),
	)
	if err != nil || result.Result != domain.LearningReadinessNotReady || result.Goal != nil || result.ActivePath == nil ||
		result.ActivePath.LearningPathID != snapshot.ActivePath.LearningPathID ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(result.ReasonCodes, []string{domain.ReadinessReasonActivePathExists}) || len(graphs.goalCodes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v graph_calls=%#v err=%v", result, graphs.goalCodes, err)
	}
}

func TestResolveScenariosEAndFRemainClosedForAmbiguousContradictoryAndUnsupportedProfiles(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		mutate     func(*domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot)
		wantResult domain.LearningReadinessResult
		wantReason string
	}{
		{
			name: "unresolved desired stacks", mutate: func(snapshot *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
				snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnresolved}
			}, wantResult: domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, wantReason: domain.ReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved,
		},
		{
			name: "multiple desired stacks", mutate: func(snapshot *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
				snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode = "backend"
				snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{"go", "python"}, ValuesPresent: true}
			}, wantResult: domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, wantReason: domain.ReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks,
		},
		{
			name: "undecided contradicts desired stack", mutate: func(snapshot *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
				snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{"go"}, ValuesPresent: true}
			}, wantResult: domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification, wantReason: domain.ReadinessReasonProfileContradictory,
		},
		{
			name: "complete unsupported stack", mutate: func(snapshot *domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) {
				snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode = "backend"
				snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{"rust"}, ValuesPresent: true}
			}, wantResult: domain.LearningReadinessNotReady, wantReason: domain.ReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported,
		},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			snapshot := foundationSnapshot()
			testCase.mutate(&snapshot)
			graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
			result, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Graphs: graphs}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
			if err != nil || result.Result != testCase.wantResult || !reflect.DeepEqual(result.ReasonCodes, []string{testCase.wantReason}) || result.Goal != nil || len(graphs.goalCodes) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("result=%#v graph_calls=%#v err=%v", result, graphs.goalCodes, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestResolveScenarioGRequiresTrustedContentLanguage(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := foundationSnapshot()
	snapshot.Profile.PreferredLanguage = &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "untrusted_persisted"}
	snapshot.Profile.ContentLanguage = nil
	result, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: snapshot}, Graphs: &readinessGraphStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if err != nil || result.Result != domain.LearningReadinessNeedsClarification ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(result.ReasonCodes, []string{domain.ReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted}) {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}

func TestResolveFlagOffMakesZeroStudentAndGraphCalls(t *testing.T) {
	student := &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: foundationSnapshot()}
	graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
	_, err := (Resolver{Enabled: false, Students: student, Graphs: graphs}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled) || student.calls != 0 || len(graphs.goalCodes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v student_calls=%d graph_calls=%#v", err, student.calls, graphs.goalCodes)
	}
}

func TestResolveRejectsStaleExpectedStateBeforeGraphLookup(t *testing.T) {
	student := &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: foundationSnapshot()}
	graphs := &readinessGraphStub{}
	input := readinessInput()
	input.Request.ExpectedStateRef = &domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 6}
	_, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: student, Graphs: graphs}).Handle(context.Background(), input)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || student.calls != 1 || len(graphs.goalCodes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v student_calls=%d graph_calls=%#v", err, student.calls, graphs.goalCodes)
	}
}

func TestResolveFailsClosedForStudentMalformedFailureAndCorruptTopology(t *testing.T) {
	malformed := foundationSnapshot()
	malformed.Profile.DesiredStacks = domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayAnswered}
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name    string
		student *readinessStudentStub
	}{
		{name: "malformed", student: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: malformed}},
		{name: "failure", student: &readinessStudentStub{err: errors.New("student unavailable")}},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: testCase.student, Graphs: &readinessGraphStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v", err)
			}
		})
	}

	graph := readinessGoalGraph("programming.foundation")
	graph.Targets[0].Prerequisites = []domain.TargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "external.target", Version: "v1"}}
	_, err := (Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: foundationSnapshot()}, Graphs: &readinessGraphStub{graph: &graph}}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid) {
		t.Fatalf("external prerequisite err=%v", err)
	}

	_, err = (Resolver{
		Enabled: true, Students: &readinessStudentStub{snapshot: foundationSnapshot()},
		Graphs: &readinessGraphStub{err: domain.ErrValidation},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), readinessInput())
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid) {
		t.Fatalf("repository validation err=%v", err)
	}
}

func readinessInput() ResolveInput {
	return ResolveInput{StudentID: readinessStudentID, Request: domain.LearningReadinessRequest{Schema: domain.LearningReadinessRequestSchema}}
}

func foundationSnapshot() domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot {
	return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: readinessStudentID,
		StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 5},
		LearningIntent: &domain.StudentReadinessLearningIntent{
			Code: "learn_programming", Source: "onboarding_goal_code.v1", Provenance: "accepted_student_draft",
		},
		Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{
			DirectionCode: "undecided", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner",
			KnownStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered},
			DesiredStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{
				State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered,
			},
			PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_text"},
			ContentLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{
				Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_text", Source: "preferred_language",
			},
		},
	}
}

func readinessGoalGraph(goalCode string) domain.GoalGraph {
	graphVersion := "programming-foundation-graph-v1"
	if goalCode == "go.backend" {
		graphVersion = "go-backend-graph-v1"
	}
	return domain.GoalGraph{
		Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: goalCode, Version: "v1", GraphVersion: graphVersion, Title: "Published graph"},
		Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{
			Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: goalCode + ".entry", Version: "v1"}, Title: "Entry",
			ModuleCode: "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", SectionCode: "section", SectionTitle: "Section",
			LessonCode: "lesson", LessonTitle: "Lesson",
		}},
	}
}

type readinessStudentStub struct {
	snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot
	err      error
	calls    int
}

func (stub *readinessStudentStub) GetPlanningReadiness(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.snapshot, stub.err
}

type readinessGraphStub struct {
	graph     *domain.GoalGraph
	err       error
	goalCodes []string
	lookups   []readinessGraphLookup
}

type readinessGraphLookup struct {
	code         string
	version      string
	graphVersion string
}

func (stub *readinessGraphStub) GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(
	_ context.Context,
	goalCode string,
	goalVersion string,
	graphVersion string,
) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	stub.goalCodes = append(stub.goalCodes, goalCode)
	stub.lookups = append(stub.lookups, readinessGraphLookup{goalCode, goalVersion, graphVersion})
	if stub.err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, stub.err
	}
	if stub.graph != nil {
		return *stub.graph, nil
	}
	return readinessGoalGraph(goalCode), nil
}
